### 5. Internal Audit Plan 2026  
**Summary:**
Head of Internal Audit presented annual audit plan for 2026 (5 audits planned).  
**2026 Audit Plan:**  
| Audit | Risk Rating | Planned Date | Expected Hours |
|-------|-------------|--------------|-----------------|
| Account Opening & KYC | High | Q2 | 40 |
| Payment Processing | High | Q3 | 35 |
| IT General Controls | Medium | Q4 | 30 |
| Fraud Detection Systems | High | Q2 | 30 |
| Operational Risk Mgmt | Medium | Q1 | 25 |  
**Total Estimated Effort:** 160 hours (within budget)  
**Committee Decision:**
✅ **APPROVED** 2026 Audit Plan.  
**Note:**
- Plan flexible for emerging risks/urgent items
- Will report quarterly on execution progress  
**Action Items:**
- Head of Internal Audit to provide Q1 audit update to next meeting
